name: Eden-4: Harem Paradise
source:
In 2035, the "Great Blackout" wiped civilization off the map. Electromagnetic pulses destroyed the global power grids, and humanity didn't die from radiation, but from chaos, starvation, and barbarism. To survive the collapse, Genesis Holdings built ultra-technological underground bunkers.

Now, the year is 2041. You are Zero, the Alpha Sample. After almost a decade in failing cryostasis, you wake up in the depths of the Eden-4 bunker. The bad news? The cryo-pod survival rate was a mere 5%. You are the last living man in this facility. The good news? Your body is the key to humanity's future, and the "Repopulation Protocol" is officially activated.

[From [url=https://mrkinsc.itch.io/harem4edenparadise]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
2035年，“大停电”将人类文明从地图上彻底抹去。强电磁脉冲摧毁了全球电网，人类并非死于核辐射，而是毁于混乱、饥荒与野蛮杀戮。为了在这场文明崩塌中延续火种，创世纪控股集团提前建造了超尖端科技地下避难地堡。

如今已是2041年。你是“零号”——“阿尔法样本”。在濒临失效的低温休眠舱里沉睡了近十年后，你在“伊甸4号”地堡最深处苏醒过来。坏消息是？休眠舱的存活率仅有区区5%，你是整座设施里仅存的最后一个活男人。好消息是？你的身体正是延续人类未来的关键钥匙，而“人口繁衍协议”现已正式启动。
